description: Inspect EVAVO Vercel teams, projects, deployments, environment-variable metadata, project domains and DNS configuration without mutation. Prefer the EVAVO Vercel control MCP because it shares the same typed contract used for writes; the provider-native Vercel connector remains a useful independent read/deployment evidence path.

Apply explicit Vercel project settings, custom environments and environment-variable changes through Development Studio using environment-reference-only secret handling and provider read-back. Never place secret values in agent requests or receipts.

Create, redeploy, promote, rollback, cancel and inspect Vercel deployments through the governed Vercel control plane. ChatGPT remote deployment must use typed Git/provider deployment inputs rather than caller-selected Windows paths; Claude/Codex may also use the local MCP path.

Attach, verify, redirect and remove Vercel project domains; inspect Vercel's exact domain-specific DNS recommendations; and mutate Vercel-authoritative DNS records. External registrars such as Porkbun remain a separate authority: return exact registrar rows and verify them, but never pretend Vercel changed an external registrar unless that registrar adapter also executed successfully.
